title: 5.1.22 Sprite Playground
description: Build a sprite playground combining canvas, a keyboard-controlled sprite (WASD or arrow keys), auto-motion, and on-screen text. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Create a canvas and two sprites
steps.instructions: Make a canvas (any size between 300×300 and 800×600) and two sprites: one `player` (controllable) and one `mover` (moves on its own).

steps.title: Wire keyboard movement to the player
steps.instructions: Use `kb.pressing(...)` with `'a'` / `'d'` / `'w'` / `'s'` (or `'left'` / `'right'` / `'up'` / `'down'`) to set the player's velocity. Include an else branch that resets velocity to 0 when no key is held.
hints: Pick one set of keys and use it for all four directions. 5.1.14 lists both sets, and 5.1.18 explains the else branch.

steps.title: Animate the mover sprite
steps.instructions: Drive the `mover` sprite with `frameCount` so it moves on its own. Pick any pattern: oscillate, orbit, or spin.
hints: Worked Example 3 in 5.1.15 shows oscillating, circling and spinning with `frameCount`.

steps.title: Add an on-screen text label
steps.instructions: Display a message on the canvas using `fill()`, `textSize()` and `text()`. Your choice of message.
hints: 5.1.21 shows all three. Call `fill('white')` before `text(...)` so the words show up on a dark background.

steps.title: Clear the background each frame
steps.instructions: Make sure `background(...)` is called each frame so previous frames don't stack up.

requirements.title: Create a canvas
requirements.description: A canvas is created when the sketch starts. Help: 5.1.5 (Canvas: new Canvas(w, h))

requirements.title: Create at least 2 sprites
requirements.description: Two sprites exist in the sketch. Help: 5.1.6 (Sprite: new Sprite(x, y, w, h) + .color)

requirements.title: Horizontal keyboard input
requirements.description: The left or right key (`'a'`, `'d'`, `'left'` or `'right'`) moves the player horizontally each frame. Help: 5.1.14 (Key names: WASD and the arrow keys)

requirements.title: Vertical keyboard input
requirements.description: The up or down key (`'w'`, `'s'`, `'up'` or `'down'`) moves the player vertically each frame. Help: 5.1.14 (Key names: WASD and the arrow keys)

requirements.title: Velocity resets to zero
requirements.description: The player stops when no movement key is held. Help: 5.1.18 (The else-to-zero rule)

requirements.title: Automatic motion for the mover
requirements.description: The mover sprite animates without keyboard input. Help: 5.1.15 (Worked Example: Keyboard Movement)

requirements.title: On-screen text label
requirements.description: A text label is drawn on the canvas. Help: 5.1.21 (Words on the canvas: text())

requirements.title: Clear the background each frame
requirements.description: Previous frames don't stack up. Help: 5.1.9 (background(color) wipe rule)
